title: ZXSpace Tips & Strategy
description: Improve your ZXSpace skills with expert tips for defending cities, managing shields, using power-ups effectively, and achieving higher scores.
summary: Master positioning, shield management, power-up timing, and scoring techniques to survive longer alien invasions and climb the leaderboards.

sections.heading: Protect Your Cities First
paragraphs: Your cities are your most valuable resource. Destroy alien formations before they break through your shields and reach the buildings below.
Losing a city reduces your chances of surviving the later waves, so prioritise defence over chasing every bonus enemy.

sections.heading: Master Your Positioning
paragraphs: Keep your cannon moving rather than waiting in one location. Good positioning allows you to intercept enemies, collect power-ups quickly, and react to sudden threats.
Try to stay near the centre of the battlefield whenever possible so you can reach either side before enemy formations become overwhelming.
bullets: Avoid staying in one position for too long.
Keep the centre of the battlefield covered.
Move early rather than reacting at the last second.

sections.heading: Use Your Shields Wisely
paragraphs: Shields provide valuable protection, but they won't last forever. Use them to absorb enemy fire while you reposition your cannon or prepare your next attack.
Repair damaged shields whenever a Shield Repair power-up appears to keep your defences strong throughout the game.
bullets: Repair damaged shield sections whenever possible.
Avoid letting aliens repeatedly attack the same area.
Protect weak sections before they collapse completely.

sections.heading: Use Power-Ups at the Right Time
paragraphs: Power-ups are most valuable when the battlefield becomes crowded. Saving offensive upgrades for the busiest waves allows you to destroy more enemies while reducing pressure on your cities.
Emergency power-ups such as EMP Pulse and Smart Bomb can completely change the outcome of a difficult wave when used at the right moment.
bullets: Save offensive upgrades for busy waves.
Use Shield Repair after heavy damage.
Keep EMP Pulse and Smart Bomb for emergencies.

sections.heading: Achieve Higher Scores
paragraphs: Higher-value enemies and bonus UFOs can dramatically increase your score, but don't risk your cities simply to chase bonus targets.
Collect a Score Multiplier before large enemy formations whenever possible to maximise the points earned during its active duration.

sections.heading: Improve Every Game
paragraphs: Every completed game teaches you something about enemy movement, wave patterns, and power-up timing. Small improvements quickly lead to longer survival times and higher scores.
Focus on surviving consistently before attempting risky high-score strategies.

images.caption: Protect your cities, survive longer, and achieve higher scores.

featureShowcases.heading: Defend Smarter, Survive Longer
featureShowcases.summary: Small improvements in positioning, shield management, and power-up timing can dramatically improve your performance.
body: ZXSpace rewards players who stay calm under pressure. Learning when to defend, when to attack, and when to collect power-ups will help you survive more waves and protect more cities.
Whether you're chasing a new personal best or aiming for the top of the Game Center leaderboards, every game is another opportunity to improve your strategy.

image.caption: Every wave is another opportunity to improve.
